{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured wool-blend blazer, tailored fit with notched lapels, charcoal gray (#36454F), fine worsted wool.  
A silk-chiffon blouse, relaxed silhouette with a subtle cowl neck, ivory white (#FFFFF0), smooth chiffon.  
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, fluid drape with a slight pleat front, stone beige (#F5F5DC), heavy crepe.  
Strappy stiletto pumps, open toe with a thin ankle strap, burgundy red (#800020), patent leather.  
A delicate gold chain necklace and small pearl drop earrings, simple geometric pendants, metallic gold (#D4AF37) and lustrous white (#FDF5E6), polished metal and cultured pearls.

This ensemble bridges the gap between daytime practicality and evening elegance perfectly suited for an autumn theater visit. The structured blazer provides a professional silhouette while the soft silk blouse adds a touch of romance appropriate for a social event. Wide-leg trousers offer comfortable movement during intermission without sacrificing sophistication, and the burgundy pumps introduce a bold, stylish accent that complements the artificial lighting of the venue."}
